title: Protocol for in vitro isolation, induction, expansion, and determination of human natural regulatory T cells and induced regulatory T cells
protocol: Extract 100 mL PBMCs from the peripheral blood of volunteers using the MCS®+ 9000 Mobile Platelet Collection System.
Mix equal volumes of PBS with PBMCs in centrifuge tubes.
Layer an equal volume of lymphoprep™ below the mixed solution, ensuring it is not pre-mixed with blood and PBS.
Centrifuge at 393 g for 23 minutes at 4°C with no acceleration or deceleration.
Collect the middle white film layer after centrifugation.
Wash the collected cells by adding one volume of PBS to the cell pellet.
Repeat washing step until the supernatant is clear, using 1 mL of leukocyte suspension and 1 mL of PBS per wash.
Collect all the cell pellets and count PBMCs.
Resuspend cell pellet in 30 μL of PBS per 10⁷ total cells.
Add 10 μL of FcR Blocking Reagent and 10 μL of CD127 Biotin per 10⁷ total cells.
Mix well and incubate for 10 min in the refrigerator (2°C–8°C).
Add 30 μL of PBS and 20 μL of Anti-Biotin MicroBeads per 10⁷ total cells.
Mix well and incubate for 15 min in the refrigerator (2°C–8°C).
Wash cells by adding 10-20 mL of PBS per 10⁸ cells.
Resuspend up to 10⁸ cells in 500 μL of PBS.
Place the cell suspension in the magnetic field of a suitable MACS Separator.
Rinse the LS Column with 2 mL of PBS.
Apply cell suspension to the LS Column.
Take unlabeled cells that pass through the column.
Perform two 1 mL PBS washing steps on the same cell suspension.
Centrifuge cell suspension and discard the supernatant.
Count cells.
For each 10⁷ total cells, suspend the cell pellet in 90 μL of PBS.
Add 10 μL of CD4+ T Cell Biotin-Antibody Cocktail to the suspended cells.
Incubate for 5 min in the refrigerator (2°C–8°C).
Mix well and incubate for another 10 min in the refrigerator (2°C–8°C) with 20 μL of Anti-Biotin MicroBeads per 10⁷ cells.
Repeat steps involving magnetic separation and washing as needed.
Centrifuge cell suspension and count cells after negative selection.
Resuspend cell pellet in 90 μL of PBS for positive selection.
Add 10 μL of CD25 MicroBeads to the suspended cells.
Mix well and incubate for 15 min in the dark in the refrigerator (2°C–8°C).
Wash cells by adding 1-2 mL of PBS, then centrifuge.
Resuspend up to 10⁸ cells in 500 μL of PBS.
Place MS Column in the magnetic field of a suitable MACS Separator.
Rinse the MS Column with 500 μL of PBS.
Apply cell suspension to the MS Column.
Wash the column with 500 μL of PBS.
Remove the MS Column from the separator and place it on a suitable collection tube.
Pipette 1 mL of PBS onto the column.
Push the plunger firmly into the column to flush out the magnetically labeled cells immediately.
Centrifuge cell suspension and count cells.
Save an aliquot after each separation step.
Check each aliquot for purity.
Take 0.3*10^6 cells in 100 μL FACS buffer.
Add staining antibodies: 0.5 μL of CD4-BV510, 0.5 μL of CD25-PE, 0.5 μL of CD127-FITC, and 0.1 μL of LIVE/DEAD™.
Incubate in the refrigerator (2°C–8°C) for 15 min in the dark.
Wash cells with 500 μL FACS buffer.
Decant the supernatant and retain about 100 μL residual volume.
Resuspend stained cells in 500 μL FACS buffer.
Analyze resuspended cells by flow cytometry.
Wash Human T-Activator CD3/CD28 Beads.
Add 25 μL Human T-Activator CD3/CD28 Beads for 10^6 nTregs.
Place the magnetic bead suspension in a 1.5 mL tube.
Place the tube in a magnetic stand and aspirate the liquid after the magnetic beads attach to the inner wall of the tube.
Resuspend magnetic beads with PBS.
Repeat step placing tube on magnetic stand and aspirating liquid.
Repeat washing and resuspending steps 3–5 times, and obtain magnetic bead precipitation.
Culture nTregs in complete medium (10% Fetal Bovine Serum and 1% Penicillin-Streptomycin Solution in Lymphocyte Serum-Free Medium) for the first 9 days.
Select a suitable culture container according to the volume of liquid, ensuring the culture liquid covers the bottom of the container.
Add 25 μL Human T-Activator CD3/CD28 Beads to 10^6 cells along with 300 IU/mL IL-2 and 100 nM/mL retinoic acid.
Maintain relative quiescence in the culture system within 48 hours after adding Human T-Activator CD3/CD28 Beads.
Incubate at 36.7°C, 5.1% CO2 for 48 hours.
Add one volume of complete medium to the initial culture volume.
Add 300 IU/mL IL-2 and 50 nM/mL retinoic acid to the total volume.
Observe the cultural solution daily.
If the color turns yellow, add IL-2, retinoic acid, and complete medium as above.
Replace flasks if the total volume of culture medium exceeds two-thirds of the bottle volume.
Culture cells for an additional 9 days during the rapid proliferation phase (day 8–15).
Centrifuge cell suspension and count cells.
(Optional) Freeze a portion of nTregs.
Add 25 μL Human T-Activator CD3/CD28 Beads to 10^6 cells.
Add 300 IU/mL IL-2 to the culture medium.
Add 100 nM/mL rapamycin to the culture medium.
Add one volume of complete medium after 48 hours of incubation.
Add 300 IU/mL IL-2 and 50 nM/mL rapamycin to the total volume.
Observe the cultural solution daily.
If the color turns yellow, add IL-2, rapamycin, and complete the medium.
Formulate the cell cryopreservation solution from 90% FBS and 10% DMSO.
Subject the formulated solution to programmed freezing for final storage in liquid nitrogen.
Take 0.3∗106 cells in 100 μLFACS buffer.
Add staining antibodies: 0.5 μL of CD4-FITC, 0.5 μL of CD25-PE, and 0.1 μL of LIVE/DEAD™ to each tube.
Vortex the tubes after adding the staining antibodies.
Incubate in the refrigerator (2°C–8°C) for 15 min in the dark.
Wash cells with 500 μL FACS buffer.
Abandon the supernatant and retain about 100 μL residual volume.
Add 500 μL 1× Fixation / Permeabilization Concentrate working solution to each tube.
Pulse vortex the tubes after adding the concentrate.
Incubate for 30–60 min in the dark in the refrigerator (2°C–8°C).
Centrifuge cell suspension and abandon the supernatant.
Add 500 μL of 1× Permeabilization PBS to each tube.
Discard the supernatant after centrifugation.
Repeat the washing step once more with 1× Permeabilization PBS.
Resuspend pellet in remaining volume of 1× Permeabilization PBS, typically 500 μL.
Add staining antibodies: 0.5 μL of Foxp3-647 to each tube.
Pulse vortex after adding the antibody.
Incubate for 30 min in the dark in the refrigerator (2°C–8°C).
Add 500 μL of 1× Permeabilization PBS to each tube.
Discard the supernatant after centrifugation.
Resuspend stained cells in 500 μL FACS buffer.
Analyze resuspended cells by flow cytometry.
Determine the cell number of PBMCs from peripheral blood and apheresis products.
For each 10⁷ total cells, suspend the cell pellet in 40 μL of PBS.
Add 10 μL of Naive CD4+ T Cell Biotin-Antibody Cocktail II to the suspension.
Incubate for 5 min in the refrigerator (2°C–8°C).
Mix well and add 20 μL of Naive CD4+ T Cell MicroBeads Cocktail II to the suspension.
Add 30 μL of PBS per 10⁷ cells to the mixture.
Proceed to magnetic separation by placing LS Column in a MACS Separator's magnetic field.
Rinse the LS Column with 3 mL of PBS.
Apply cell suspension to the column.
Collect unlabeled cells that pass through the column.
Wash collected cells twice with 1 mL of PBS each.
Sort CD4+ T cells from PBMCs by MACS.
Identify the purity of naïve CD4+ T cells by flow cytometry.
Culture sorted CD4+ T cells with TGF-β, IL-2, and atRA to generate iTregs.
Centrifuge cell suspension and count cells.
Take 0.3∗10^6 cells in 100 μL FACS buffer.
Add staining antibodies: 0.5 μL of CD4-BV510, 0.5 μL of CD45RA-PE, and 0.1 μL of LIVE/DEAD™ to each tube.
Vortex the tubes.
Incubate in the refrigerator (2°C–8°C) for 15 min in the dark.
Wash cells with 500 μL FACS buffer, abandon the supernatant, and retain about 100 μL residual volume.
Resuspend stained cells in 500 μL FACS buffer.
Analyze resuspended cells by flow cytometry.
Wash Human T-Activator CD3/CD28 Beads.
Place 25 μL Human T-Activator CD3/CD28 Beads in a 1.5 mL tube for each 10^6 nTregs.
Place the tube on a magnetic stand and aspirate liquid after beads attach to the inner wall of the tube.
Resuspend magnetic beads with PBS.
Repeat steps involving washing and resuspending magnetic beads 3–5 times, obtaining magnetic bead precipitation.
Induce naïve CD4+ T cells into iTregs.
Culture naïve CD4+ T cells at 5*10^5/mL in complete medium (10% Fetal Bovine Serum and 1% Penicillin-Streptomycin Solution in Lymphocyte Serum-Free Medium).
Add 25 μL Human T-Activator CD3/CD28 Beads to 10^6 cells.
Add 100 IU/mL IL-2, 1 ng/mL TGF-β, and 100 nM/mL retinoic acid to the culture.
Incubate for 48 hours.
Add one volume of complete medium after initial incubation.
Add 300 IU/mL IL-2 and 50 nM/mL rapamycin to the total volume (e.g., 1 mL initial culture volume, addition of 1 mL incubation solution, 600 IU IL-2 and 100 nM retinoic acid).
Observe the cultural solution daily.
Add IL-2, retinoic acid, and complete medium if the color turns yellow.
Take 0.3*10^6 cells in 100 μL FACS buffer for identification of iTregs by flow cytometry.
Add staining antibodies (0.5 μL CD4-FITC, 0.5 μL CD25-Percp/Cy5.5, and 0.1 μL LIVE/DEAD™) to each tube and vortex.
Incubate in the refrigerator (2°C–8°C) for 15 min in the dark.
Wash cells with 500 μL FACS buffer.
Abandon the supernatant and retain about 100 μL residual volume.
Add 500 μL of 1× Fixation/Permeabilization Concentrate working solution to each tube.
Pulse vortex the tubes.
Incubate the tubes for 30–60 min in the dark in the refrigerator (2°C–8°C).
Centrifuge the cell suspension and discard the supernatant.
Add 500 μL of 1× Permeabilization PBS to each tube.
Discard the supernatant after centrifugation.
Repeat the previous two steps once more.
Resuspend the pellet in remaining volume of 1× Permeabilization PBS, typically 500 μL.
Add 0.5 μL of Foxp3-647 staining antibody to each tube.
Pulse vortex and incubate for 30 min in the dark in the refrigerator (2°C–8°C).
Centrifuge the tubes after incubation and discard the supernatant.
Resuspend stained cells in 500 μL FACS buffer.
Analyze resuspended cells by flow cytometry.
Remove excess microplate strips from the foil pouch if not all will be used.
Place removed strips back in the foil pouch with the desiccant pack and reseal.
Wash plate 4 times with at least 300 μL Wash PBS per well, then blot residual PBS by firmly tapping upside down on absorbent paper.
Add 100 μL of standards and assay samples to the reaction wells after blocking, incubate at 25°C with shaking for 120 min.
Wash plate 4 times with Wash PBS.
Add 100 μL of biotinylated antibody working solution to the reaction wells after blocking, then incubate with shaking for 60 min at 25°C.
Wash plate 4 times with Wash PBS.
Add 100 μL of enzyme conjugate working solution to the reaction wells and incubate at 25°C with shaking for 30 min.
Wash plate 5 times with Wash PBS.
Add 100 μL chromogenic substrate to the reaction wells, develop color at 25°C in the dark for 15 min after sealing the plate.
Add 50 μL stop solution and measure OD immediately (within 15 min) at 450 nm using a microplate reader.
Determine the cell number of PBMCs.
Resuspend cell pellet in 80 μL of PBS per 10^7 total cells.
Add 20 μL of CD8 MicroBeads per 10^7 total cells.
Mix well and incubate for 15 min in the refrigerator (2°C–8°C).
Wash cells by adding 1 mL–2 mL of PBS per 10^7 cells, and resuspend up to 10^8 cells in 500 μL of PBS.
Place MS Column in the magnetic field of a suitable MACS Separator.
Rinse the column with 500 μL of PBS.
Apply cell suspension to the column.
Wash the column with 500 μL of PBS.
Remove the column from the separator, and place it on a suitable collection tube.
Pipette 1 mL of PBS onto the column.
Push the plunger firmly into the column to flush out the magnetically labeled cells immediately.
Centrifuge cell suspension and count cells.
Resuspend 1–10*10^6 CD8+ cells in 1 mL PBS.
Add 1 μL CFSE Cell Proliferation Kit and mix well.
Incubate cells for 30 min in a 37°C Incubator.
Add 5 mL of Lymphocyte Serum-Free Medium to stop staining.
Ice bath for 5 minutes.
Wash three times with PBS.
Culture Tregs at a concentration of 10^6/mL in complete medium.
Add 5 μL of Human T-Activator CD3/CD28 Beads per 10^6 CD8+T cells.
Incubate for 72–96 hours.
Take 0.3×10^6 cells in 100 μL FACS buffer.
Add staining antibodies: 0.5 μL of CD4-FITC, 0.5 μL of CD25-Percp/Cy5.5, and 0.1 μL of LIVE/DEAD™ to each tube.
Vortex the tubes.
Incubate in the refrigerator (2°C–8°C) for 15 minutes in the dark.
Wash cells with 500 μL FACS buffer.
Abandon the supernatant.
Retain about 100 μL residual volume.
Resuspend stained cells in 500 μL FACS buffer.
Analyze by flow cytometry.
